lines: Cold up here. The snow keeps everything quiet.
npcWhitecombs.greet.speaker: npcWhitecombs

lines: Two bears den on the rock below. I can't get past.
npcWhitecombs.offer.speaker: npcWhitecombs

lines: Still denned. I can smell them from here.
npcWhitecombs.notReady.speaker: npcWhitecombs

lines: The rock is clear. Three draughts. You'll need them.
npcWhitecombs.thanks.speaker: npcWhitecombs
